entries.note: MX-1 sentence verbatim; untested at first use.

Rugo 2016 full text: 'Our design did not evaluate the individual contributions of veliparib and carboplatin.' The model's prediction (veliparib adds to carboplatin) was never isolated; the pCR gain is attributable to a condition the model did not test. Untested, source_calls_it unresolved.
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: decision 4 states the untested-conditions rule for contra only (#35, #72); #57 covers disclaimed failures; the checker brief extends it to same. Is a met primary with the class drug's contribution unisolated same or untested?

entries.note: Contra stands: veliparib added nothing to carboplatin (53% vs 58%). Donawho's potentiation claim spanned BRCA-wt models, and Loibl does not attribute the miss to genotype. Geyer 2022 and Han 2018 quotes verbatim; registry dates verified; abstract-only for gBRCA subgroup.
Rottenberg 2008 (PMC2579381) resolves; sentence verbatim. Sibling drug (olaparib) in model, product_in_model false is right.
Somlo 2017 sentence verbatim; NCT01149083 results posted 2025-08-15, epub 2017-03-29 earliest. Single-arm ORR in the GEMM-named genotype: same, direction_only, is the right call.

PFS sentence verbatim; NCT02163694 results 2022-04-04, epub 2020-08-27. BROCADE 2018 (missed PFS, ORR significant) is untested under decision 4, not contra, so track stays same. strengthens is defined for a second miss, not a second match.
ORR sentence verbatim; NCT03575065 results 2022-09-07 precede epub 2022-12-02, year 2022 right. Same flag caveat as index 6.

Full text (PMC7434893): DRP retrodiction in 13 mixed-tumour patients; both gBRCA breast patients progressed. NCT03562832 completed 2024-08, no results; web search found no 2X-121 breast release (hits were LiPlaCis 2023, a 2017 'planned study' note). SEC filings not checked.

Sentence verbatim. Full text: toxicity judged on weight loss, apathy and necropsy only; no haematology measured. Paper also states increased cisplatin nephrotoxicity with AZD2281, a stated combination prediction the draft does not score.

Contra supported as askable silence: mice can show cytopenias, Rottenberg measured none yet claimed 'excellent therapeutic index'; pamiparib monotherapy gave grade 3+ haematologic TEAEs, 64.8% dose reductions. Low confidence is right; see rule question 2.
Daemen 2012 (PMC3429780, epub 2012-08-09) resolves; sentence verbatim in full text. Opening untested for an olaparib-built signature, product_in_model false, prediction_level patient, is right.

Quote near-verbatim (full text); QBE pre-specified. Arm added carboplatin to control; Wolf defers 'carboplatin alone', BrighTNess found veliparib adds nothing, Tovey 2023 shows DDR signatures predict carboplatin. PARPi prediction never isolated: untested, unresolved; mirrors adjudicated efficacy[2].
entries.adjudication_note: RULE QUESTION: as efficacy[2]: decision 4 states the untested-conditions rule for contra only (#35, #72); the arm co-added carboplatin, so the PARPi prediction is unisolated. Is a met pre-specified interaction same or untested? Same, consistent with efficacy[2].

entries.note: McGonigle 2015 (PMC4747407) resolves; PD sentence verbatim. Opening untested for a member drug's own xenograft is right; MX-1 chemopotentiation folded into one track is one system.

Plummer 2020 (PMC7434893, epub 2020-06-11) resolves; sentence verbatim. Mixed-tumour patient PBMC PAR allowed for engagement; proximal, direction_only right; Plummer cites the xenograft PD without comparing, so paired is correct.

Sentence verbatim. Full text: '30 or 100 mg/kg was well-tolerated without any significant body weight loss or deaths (data not shown)', so the model's margin is a data-not-shown sentence; opening untested is right.

Quote verbatim. MTD 600 mg QD is the PD-saturating dose; DLTs 1/6 at 600 (anaphylaxis), 4/6 at 800 (fatigue). No toxicity at or below the effective exposure, so decision 16 same; low confidence right given data-not-shown mouse tolerability.

Abstract sentence verbatim (PMC4747407). Untested right: Plummer's two gBRCA breast progressors are n=2 in a mixed escalation; NCT03562832 has no results or paper and the prior checker found no 2X-121 breast release.

Sentence verbatim (Discussion). A stated prediction (no TNKS-type intestinal toxicity) a mouse can test. Full text also reports body-weight loss with the TMZ combination, a combination prediction the draft does not score.

Quote verbatim. No intestinal DLT (DLTs: anaphylaxis 600 mg, fatigue 800 mg); diarrhoea 29% any grade; rash, photosensitivity, chromaturia unpredicted. Same on the stated intestinal prediction with partial is defensible; imported mixed-tumour phase 1 allowed for safety.

Xiong 2020 (PMC7350150, epub 2020-07-08) resolves; sentence verbatim. Opening untested; the IND-era xenograft published after the phase 1 start (2015) but before Lickliter (epub 2021) is not a retrodiction, proxy year noted.
Lickliter 2022 (PMC8854719) epub 2021-11-18, year 2021 right; sentence verbatim. PBMC PAR plateau ~80% from 10 mg BID in mixed solid tumours; same, proximal, direction_only.

Sentence verbatim (figure legend; text: 'No body weight loss was observed during the treatment'). Opening untested; the tolerated-at-efficacious-dose statement at 1.6-12.5 mg/kg BID is the only margin stated.

Quote verbatim. PAR plateau 10 mg BID vs RP2D 60 and MTD 80 mg BID; DLTs were grade 2 nausea (40-80 mg) and grade 3 fatigue (120 mg); nothing at or below the effective exposure, so decision 16 same with margin_stated true.

Xiong 2020 sentence verbatim (Discussion). Opening untested; genotype-selected single-agent regression as a patient-level prediction on pamiparib's own system, distinct from the olaparib GEMM, is right.

Xu 2023 abstract quote verbatim; registry results 2022-09-07 precede epub 2022-12-02, year 2022 right. Single-arm gBRCA ORR scored same, direction_only, consistent with efficacy[5] and [7] on the GEMM track.

Sentence verbatim (figure legend). Full text: body weight twice weekly was the only tolerability readout; no haematology, 'tolerat' absent. Opening untested fine; whether this silence is askable is rule question 2.

Quote verbatim (abstract). Contra follows the safety[2] reading pending rule question 2. Lickliter 2022 (epub 2021-11-18: grade>=3 anaemia 24.8%, neutropenia 5.9%, haematologic dose reductions 23.8%) is the first admissible patient dataset; date 2021 with imported_from, as E7449 safety[4] does.
entries.adjudication_note: Both sides contra (askable silence, open rule question 2). Rule 6 dates at earliest public comparison and safety transfers across populations: Lickliter 2022, epub 2021-11-18, grade>=3 anaemia 24.8% on pamiparib, so year 2021 with imported_from.

entries.note: Bui 2026 (PMC13522806, epub 2026-08-06) resolves; AUC sentence verbatim. Opening untested in the comparison year with the model entry first on the same-year collision is right.

Quote verbatim. Built after I-SPY 2, BrighTNess and Geyer 2022: retro, not same. Full text: sensitive TORG146 responded to cisplatin with or without veliparib; concordance is with a patient-trained classifier, so low confidence and partial are right.

missing: PARPi-7 and BRCA1ness cell-line-derived expression signatures, pre-specified and tested against pCR in the I-SPY 2 veliparib/carboplatin arm (patient-level, in_silico): 'PARPi-7, BRCA1ness, and MP1/2 specifically associated with response in the VC arm but not the control arm.' Wolf 2017, NPJ Breast Cancer, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41523-017-0025-7 (PMC5572474). Same carboplatin confound as efficacy[2].

2X-121 (E7449)'s own BRCA-deficient xenografts: 'single agent had significant antitumor activity in BRCA-deficient xenografts' and 'the lack of toxicity'. McGonigle 2015, Oncotarget, https://doi.org/10.18632/oncotarget.5846 (PMC4747407). A member drug's own model with no track; opens untested 2015 (breast patient data unreported; Plummer 2020's two gBRCA breast patients progressed).

Pamiparib's own preclinical package (Xiong 2020, J Med Chem, https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jmedchem.0c01346: PARP1/2 IC50 1.3/0.9 nM, cellular PARylation IC50 0.2 nM, brain penetration; xenograft efficacy in full text, not checked). Paired with Xu 2023 it is a member drug's own model with no track; the draft scores pamiparib on the olaparib GEMM only.

Kummar 2009's mouse PK/PD model (0.21 umol/L plasma target from single-dose PAR studies in mice) is stated in the source, not a pairing; same MX-1 track, so a field fix (comparison_stated true) rather than a new track.
rule_questions: When a trial's own authors state the design cannot separate the class drug from a co-added chemotherapy (Rugo 2016: 'did not evaluate the individual contributions of veliparib and carboplatin'), is a met primary endpoint untested (prediction never isolated) or same with source_calls_it unresolved? Decision 4 states the 'conditions the model never tested' rule only for contra.

Does an efficacy GEMM that reports 'no signs of toxicity' from weight, behaviour and necropsy alone count as askable silence on haematological toxicity (contra when patients show cytopenias), or must a scoreable safety prediction come from a study that measured the harm?

A BRCA-deficient xenograft's chemopotentiation tested in a biomarker-unselected trial (BrighTNess, gBRCA stratified, roughly 15%) that fails overall with the genotype subgroup underpowered: contra on the model, as drafted, or untested under the 80% biomarker rule read in reverse? Confirmed contra here because Donawho's claim also covered BRCA-wt models.

strengthens: true is defined (decision 7, #127) for a second miss that removes the first miss's excuse; the draft uses it for repeat matches (BROCADE3, pamiparib). Should repeat matches be entries or go to patient_trials?
